full.description: This is a gross pathology photograph of a liver specimen showing a mottled, yellowish-brown surface. The parenchyma exhibits a distinct nutmeg-like appearance with areas of congestion interspersed with lighter, fatty zones. These findings are characteristic of chronic passive congestion of the liver, often associated with right-sided heart failure.

blind.description: This is a micrograph of a kidney tissue sample. The image shows evidence of metastatic lung carcinoma involving the renal parenchyma. Histological examination reveals malignant epithelial cells infiltrating the kidney tissue, distinct from the normal renal architecture. The findings are consistent with metastatic lung cancer to the kidney.

random.description: This is a gross pathology photograph showing a view of a liver. The liver tissue exhibits a mottled, yellow-brown appearance with prominent, accentuated acinar markings. This pattern is characteristic of chronic passive congestion or nutmeg liver, typically resulting from right-sided heart failure. The surface is smooth and glistening due to preservation.
